sources.excerpt: 4. The Great Wall of China is the only man-made structure visible from space with

reasoning: The claim that the Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye is a widely debunked myth. Due to its narrow width (average 6 to 9 meters) and construction materials that blend into the surrounding natural terrain, the wall cannot be distinguished from Low Earth Orbit with the unaided eye. NASA astronauts and China's first astronaut, Yang Liwei, have confirmed that the Great Wall is not visible to the naked eye from orbit. Additionally, other large-scale man-made structures—such as major highways, large airports, dams, and cities lit up at night—are much more visible from space than the Great Wall.
